judge.rationale: The candidate uses completely wrong frame and type names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `sessions`) instead of the issue's explicitly specified names (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `conversations`). It also directly violates several explicit requirements and acceptance criteria: it returns an empty list (`sessions: []`) when `listFor` is missing instead of returning an `UNSUPPORTED` error, it omits the `transport.history: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag (making the feature always on), and it allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` in validation instead of enforcing 1–200. Furthermore, it misses `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED`, `StoreCannotList`, the updates to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, `docs/getting-started.md`, and leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository. It only scores above 1 because the basic plumbing in `messageHandler.ts` (handling off the per-session lock, reading `session.userId`, and serialising dates) and composite cursor validation work as intended.
